## Checklist

<!-- The long form of each item is in CONTRIBUTING.md; this list mirrors it. -->

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally (typecheck, lint, and unit tests at 100% coverage)
- [ ] `pnpm build` succeeds locally
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` passes, if this touches navigation, forms, layout, a color or design token, or a control that
      inherits browser styling
- [ ] Any data adapter change (`src/lib/congress/**`) includes a fixture or unit test for the upstream shape it supports
- [ ] No secrets, raw API-key URLs, or user data are committed
- [ ] Preview/demo data is still clearly labeled and fictional
- [ ] No new or changed status label could be mistaken for an official legal determination
- [ ] No editorial judgment about a member or bill, and nothing shown that Congress.gov does not publish
